description: This Dart source file defines a HabitService class that provides methods to interact with a backend API for managing habits. It includes methods for retrieving, adding, and deleting habits, utilizing an ApiClient for HTTP requests and working with Habit model objects.

classes.name: HabitService
classes.description: A service class that communicates with the backend API to perform CRUD operations related to habits.

methods.name: getHabits
methods.description: Fetches the list of habits from the backend API.

methods.name: addHabit
methods.description: Adds a new habit with the specified name and frequency to the backend.

methods.name: deleteHabit
methods.description: Deletes a habit identified by its ID from the backend.
